a.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is back. What happens next?

b.lede: Jensen Huang admitted to more affairs than the two that Nvidia's board members were already aware of before they agreed to let him return to the company as CEO, President, and board member, amid reports that one of the women involved is a Chinese spy.
